title: एकत्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Yudhishthira says that the story shows how hard brahmanhood is, and asks how the king Vitahavya reached it. Bhishma tells of the Haihaya king Vitahavya, who fought King Divodasa of Kashi, and of how Divodasa's son Pratardana pursued him to the hermitage of Bhrigu, who by his word made the king a brahmin.
summary.kn: ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣತ್ವ ಎಷ್ಟು ಕಷ್ಟವೆಂದು ಈ ಕಥೆ ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ, ರಾಜ ವೀತಹವ್ಯ ಅದನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಪಡೆದನೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಹೈಹಯ ರಾಜ ವೀತಹವ್ಯ ಕಾಶಿಯ ದಿವೋದಾಸನೊಡನೆ ಹೋರಾಡಿದ, ದಿವೋದಾಸನ ಮಗ ಪ್ರತರ್ದನ ಭೃಗುವಿನ ಆಶ್ರಮದವರೆಗೆ ಬೆನ್ನಟ್ಟಿದಾಗ ಋಷಿ ತನ್ನ ಮಾತಿನಿಂದ ಅವನನ್ನು ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣನನ್ನಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿದ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर कहते हैं कि कथा से दिखता है ब्राह्मणत्व कितना कठिन है और पूछते हैं कि राजा वीतहव्य ने उसे कैसे पाया। भीष्म हैहय राजा वीतहव्य के काशी के दिवोदास से युद्ध और दिवोदास के पुत्र प्रतर्दन के भृगु के आश्रम तक पीछा करने की कथा कहते हैं, जहाँ भृगु ने अपने वचन से राजा को ब्राह्मण बना दिया।
summary.te: బ్రాహ్మణత్వం ఎంత కష్టమో ఈ కథ చూపుతుందని, రాజు వీతహవ్యుడు దాన్ని ఎలా పొందాడని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. హైహయ రాజు వీతహవ్యుడు కాశీ రాజు దివోదాసుతో పోరాడగా, దివోదాసు కొడుకు ప్రతర్దనుడు భృగువు ఆశ్రమం వరకు వెంటాడగా ఋషి తన మాటతో రాజును బ్రాహ్మణుని చేశాడు.
summary.ta: அந்தணத்துவம் எவ்வளவு கடினம் என்று இக்கதை காட்டுகிறது, மன்னன் வீதஹவ்யன் அதை எவ்வாறு அடைந்தான் என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, ஹைஹய மன்னன் வீதஹவ்யன் காசி மன்னன் திவோதாசனுடன் போரிட்டதையும் திவோதாசனின் மகன் பிரதர்தனன் பிருகுவின் ஆசிரமம்வரை துரத்தியபோது முனிவர் தம் சொல்லால் அவனை அந்தணனாக்கியதையும் பீஷ்மர் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: ബ്രാഹ്മണ്യം എത്ര കഠിനമാണെന്ന് ഈ കഥ കാണിക്കുന്നുവെന്നും, ഹൈഹയ രാജാവായ വിതഹവ്യൻ അത് എങ്ങനെ നേടിയെന്നും യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. കാശിരാജാവായ ദിവോദാസനോട് യുദ്ധം ചെയ്ത വിതഹവ്യന്റെ കഥയും, ദിവോദാസന്റെ പുത്രനായ പ്രതർദനൻ അദ്ദേഹത്തെ ഭൃഗുവിന്റെ ആശ്രമംവരെ പിന്തുടർന്നതും ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു; ഭൃഗു തന്റെ വാക്കുകൊണ്ട് ആ രാജാവിനെ ബ്രാഹ്മണനാക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.31; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
श्रुतं मे महदाख्यानमेतत्कुरुकुलोद्वह ।
सुदुष्प्रापं ब्रवीषि त्वं ब्राह्मण्यं वदतां वर ॥

meaning.en: Scion of the Kurus, best of speakers, I have heard this great account in which you call brahminhood very hard to attain.

verses.text:
विश्वामित्रेण च पुरा ब्राह्मण्यं प्राप्तमित्युत ।
श्रूयते वदसे तच्च दुष्प्रापमिति सत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Best of men, it is also said that Vishvamitra attained brahminhood long ago, and yet you say it is hard to reach.

verses.text:
वीतहव्यश्च राजर्षिः श्रुतो मे विप्रतां गतः ।
तदेव तावद्गाङ्गेय श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यहं विभो ॥

meaning.en: I have also heard that the royal sage Vitahavya became a brahmin. Son of Ganga, mighty one, I wish to hear that very story first.

verses.text:
स केन कर्मणा प्राप्तो ब्राह्मण्यं राजसत्तम ।
वरेण तपसा वापि तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: Best of kings, by what deed did he gain brahminhood, by a boon or by austerity? Please explain this to me.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
शृणु राजन्यथा राजा वीतहव्यो महायशाः ।
क्षत्रियः सन्पुनः प्राप्तो ब्राह्मण्यं लोकसत्कृतम् ॥

meaning.en: Listen, king, how the famous king Vitahavya, though a kshatriya, came to win the brahminhood that the world honors.

verses.text:
मनोर्महात्मनस्तात प्रजाधर्मेण शासतः ।
बभूव पुत्रो धर्मात्मा शर्यातिरिति विश्रुतः ॥

meaning.en: My son, to the great Manu, who ruled according to the duty of a king toward his subjects, was born a righteous son known as Sharyati.

verses.text:
तस्यान्ववाये द्वौ राजन्राजानौ संबभूवतुः ।
हेहयस्तालजङ्घश्च वत्सेषु जयतां वर ॥

meaning.en: In his line, O king, two kings arose, Haihaya and Talajangha, best of conquerors, among the Vatsas.

verses.text:
हेहयस्य तु पुत्राणां दशसु स्त्रीषु भारत ।
शतं बभूव प्रख्यातं शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम् ॥

meaning.en: Haihaya, Bharata, had a hundred famous sons by his ten wives, heroes who never turned back from battle.

verses.text:
तुल्यरूपप्रभावाणां विदुषां युद्धशालिनाम् ।
धनुर्वेदे च वेदे च सर्वत्रैव कृतश्रमाः ॥

meaning.en: They were alike in looks and power, learned and fond of fighting, and had labored at archery and the Veda everywhere.

verses.text:
काशिष्वपि नृपो राजन्दिवोदासपितामहः ।
हर्यश्व इति विख्यातो बभूव जयतां वरः ॥

meaning.en: Among the Kashis too there was a king, grandfather of Divodasa, named Haryashva, a best of conquerors.

verses.text:
स वीतहव्यदायादैरागत्य पुरुषर्षभ ।
गङ्गायमुनयोर्मध्ये संग्रामे विनिपातितः ॥

meaning.en: Bull among men, the heirs of Vitahavya came and struck him down in battle between the Ganga and the Yamuna.

verses.text:
तं तु हत्वा नरवरं हेहयास्ते महारथाः ।
प्रतिजग्मुः पुरीं रम्यां वत्सानामकुतोभयाः ॥

meaning.en: Having killed that foremost of men, those great Haihaya charioteers went back fearless to the lovely city of the Vatsas.

verses.text:
हर्यश्वस्य तु दायादः काशिराजोऽभ्यषिच्यत ।
सुदेवो देवसंकाशः साक्षाद्धर्म इवापरः ॥

meaning.en: Haryashva's heir was consecrated as king of Kashi: Sudeva, godlike, like a second Dharma in person.

verses.text:
स पालयन्नेव महीं धर्मात्मा काशिनन्दनः ।
तैर्वीतहव्यैरागत्य युधि सर्वैर्विनिर्जितः ॥

meaning.en: While that righteous son of Kashi was ruling the earth, the Vitahavyas came again and utterly defeated him in battle.

verses.text:
तमप्याजौ विनिर्जित्य प्रतिजग्मुर्यथागतम् ।
सौदेविस्त्वथ काशीशो दिवोदासोऽभ्यषिच्यत ॥

meaning.en: Having beaten him too in the fight, they went back as they had come. Then Sudeva's son Divodasa was consecrated lord of Kashi.

verses.text:
दिवोदासस्तु विज्ञाय वीर्यं तेषां महात्मनाम् ।
वाराणसीं महातेजा निर्ममे शक्रशासनात् ॥

meaning.en: Divodasa, of great splendor, knew the strength of those mighty men and, at Indra's bidding, built Varanasi.

verses.text:
विप्रक्षत्रियसंबाधां वैश्यशूद्रसमाकुलाम् ।
नैकद्रव्योच्चयवतीं समृद्धविपणापणाम् ॥

meaning.en: It was crowded with brahmins and kshatriyas and thronged with vaishyas and shudras, with heaps of many kinds of wealth and with prosperous markets and shops.

verses.text:
गङ्गाया उत्तरे कूले वप्रान्ते राजसत्तम ।
गोमत्या दक्षिणे चैव शक्रस्येवामरावतीम् ॥

meaning.en: Best of kings, it stood on the northern bank of the Ganga and south of the Gomati, ending at the rampart, like Indra's Amaravati.

verses.text:
तत्र तं राजशार्दूलं निवसन्तं महीपतिम् ।
आगत्य हेहया भूयः पर्यधावन्त भारत ॥

meaning.en: As that tiger among kings lived there, the Haihayas came again, Bharata, and surrounded him.

verses.text:
स निष्पत्य ददौ युद्धं तेभ्यो राजा महाबलः ।
देवासुरसमं घोरं दिवोदासो महाद्युतिः ॥

meaning.en: The mighty, radiant king Divodasa sallied out and fought them in a fearsome battle like that of gods and asuras.

verses.text:
स तु युद्धे महाराज दिनानां दशतीर्दश ।
हतवाहनभूयिष्ठस्ततो दैन्यमुपागमत् ॥

meaning.en: Great king, he fought for ten times ten days, until most of his mounts were slain, and then he fell into despair.

verses.text:
हतयोधस्ततो राजन्क्षीणकोशश्च भूमिपः ।
दिवोदासः पुरीं हित्वा पलायनपरोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: His warriors dead and his treasury spent, the king Divodasa left his city and fled.

verses.text:
स त्वाश्रममुपागम्य भरद्वाजस्य धीमतः ।
जगाम शरणं राजा कृताञ्जलिररिंदम ॥

meaning.en: Reaching the hermitage of the wise Bharadvaja, the king, scourge of foes, took refuge there with joined palms.

verses.text: राजोवाच

meaning.en: The king said:

verses.text:
भगवन्वैतहव्यैर्मे युद्धे वंशः प्रणाशितः ।
अहमेकः परिद्यूनो भवन्तं शरणं गतः ॥

meaning.en: Venerable one, the Vitahavyas have destroyed my family in battle. I alone am left, crushed, and I have come to you for refuge.

verses.text:
शिष्यस्नेहेन भगवन्स मां रक्षितुमर्हसि ।
निःशेषो हि कृतो वंशो मम तैः पापकर्मभिः ॥

meaning.en: Out of a teacher's affection for a pupil, venerable one, you ought to protect me. Those evildoers have left my line with nothing remaining.

verses.text:
तमुवाच महाभागो भरद्वाजः प्रतापवान् ।
न भेतव्यं न भेतव्यं सौदेव व्येतु ते भयम् ॥

meaning.en: The mighty and blessed Bharadvaja said to him: Do not fear, do not fear, son of Sudeva. Let your fear go.

verses.text:
अहमिष्टिं करोम्यद्य पुत्रार्थं ते विशां पते ।
वैतहव्यसहस्राणि यथा त्वं प्रसहिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: Lord of the people, today I will perform a sacrifice for the sake of a son for you, so that you will overcome thousands of Vitahavyas.

verses.text:
तत इष्टिं चकारर्षिस्तस्य वै पुत्रकामिकीम् ।
अथास्य तनयो जज्ञे प्रतर्दन इति श्रुतः ॥

meaning.en: Then the sage performed for him the sacrifice for obtaining a son, and a son was born to him, known as Pratardana.

verses.text:
स जातमात्रो ववृधे समाः सद्यस्त्रयोदश ।
वेदं चाधिजगे कृत्स्नं धनुर्वेदं च भारत ॥

meaning.en: As soon as he was born he grew, reaching in an instant the size of a thirteen-year-old, and he learned the whole Veda and archery, Bharata.

verses.text:
योगेन च समाविष्टो भरद्वाजेन धीमता ।
तेजो लौक्यं स संगृह्य तस्मिन्देशे समाविशत् ॥

meaning.en: The wise Bharadvaja endowed him with yogic power, and gathering the radiance of the world, it entered him.

verses.text:
ततः स कवची धन्वी बाणी दीप्त इवानलः ।
प्रययौ स धनुर्धुन्वन्विवर्षुरिव तोयदः ॥

meaning.en: Then, armored, with bow and arrows, blazing like fire, he set out twanging his bow, like a rain cloud about to pour.

verses.text:
तं दृष्ट्वा परमं हर्षं सुदेवतनयो ययौ ।
मेने च मनसा दग्धान्वैतहव्यान्स पार्थिवः ॥

meaning.en: Seeing him, Sudeva's son was filled with great joy, and the king felt in his mind that the Vitahavyas were already burned.

verses.text:
ततस्तं यौवराज्येन स्थापयित्वा प्रतर्दनम् ।
कृतकृत्यं तदात्मानं स राजा अभ्यनन्दत ॥

meaning.en: Then he installed Pratardana as heir apparent, and the king rejoiced that his purpose was fulfilled.

verses.text:
ततस्तु वैतहव्यानां वधाय स महीपतिः ।
पुत्रं प्रस्थापयामास प्रतर्दनमरिंदमम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the king sent his son Pratardana, scourge of foes, to destroy the Vitahavyas.

verses.text:
सरथः स तु संतीर्य गङ्गामाशु पराक्रमी ।
प्रययौ वीतहव्यानां पुरीं परपुरंजयः ॥

meaning.en: The mighty conqueror of enemy cities crossed the Ganga swiftly in his chariot and went to the city of the Vitahavyas.

verses.text:
वैतहव्यास्तु संश्रुत्य रथघोषं समुद्धतम् ।
निर्ययुर्नगराकारै रथैः पररथारुजैः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing the fierce rumble of his chariot, the Vitahavyas came out in chariots as big as cities, able to crush enemy chariots.

verses.text:
निष्क्रम्य ते नरव्याघ्रा दंशिताश्चित्रयोधिनः ।
प्रतर्दनं समाजघ्नुः शरवर्षैरुदायुधाः ॥

meaning.en: Those tiger-like men marched out, armored, skilled in varied fighting, weapons raised, and struck Pratardana with showers of arrows.

verses.text:
अस्त्रैश्च विविधाकारै रथौघैश्च युधिष्ठिर ।
अभ्यवर्षन्त राजानं हिमवन्तमिवाम्बुदाः ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira, they rained weapons of many kinds and masses of chariots upon the king, as clouds pour on the Himalaya.

verses.text:
अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य तेषां राजा प्रतर्दनः ।
जघान तान्महातेजा वज्रानलसमैः शरैः ॥

meaning.en: King Pratardana, of great fire, countered their weapons with his own and killed them with arrows like thunderbolts and flames.

verses.text:
कृत्तोत्तमाङ्गास्ते राजन्भल्लैः शतसहस्रशः ।
अपतन्रुधिरार्द्राङ्गा निकृत्ता इव किंशुकाः ॥

meaning.en: O king, with broad arrows he cut off their heads by the hundred thousand, and they fell with blood-soaked limbs like severed kimshuka blossoms.

verses.text:
हतेषु तेषु सर्वेषु वीतहव्यः सुतेष्वथ ।
प्राद्रवन्नगरं हित्वा भृगोराश्रममप्युत ॥

meaning.en: When all his sons had been killed, Vitahavya abandoned his city and fled to the hermitage of Bhrigu.

verses.text:
ययौ भृगुं च शरणं वीतहव्यो नराधिपः ।
अभयं च ददौ तस्मै राज्ञे राजन्भृगुस्तथा ।
ततो ददावासनं च तस्मै शिष्यो भृगोस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: King Vitahavya took refuge with Bhrigu, and Bhrigu gave that king assurance of safety. Then Bhrigu's disciple offered him a seat.

verses.text:
अथानुपदमेवाशु तत्रागच्छत्प्रतर्दनः ।
स प्राप्य चाश्रमपदं दिवोदासात्मजोऽब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Right on his trail Pratardana soon arrived there. Reaching the hermitage, Divodasa's son called out.

verses.text:
भो भोः केऽत्राश्रमे सन्ति भृगोः शिष्या महात्मनः ।
द्रष्टुमिच्छे मुनिमहं तस्याचक्षत मामिति ॥

meaning.en: Ho! Which disciples of the great Bhrigu are in this hermitage? I wish to see the sage; tell him of me.

verses.text:
स तं विदित्वा तु भृगुर्निश्चक्रामाश्रमात्तदा ।
पूजयामास च ततो विधिना परमेण ह ॥

meaning.en: Knowing who it was, Bhrigu came out of the hermitage and honored him with the highest ceremony.

verses.text:
उवाच चैनं राजेन्द्र किं कार्यमिति पार्थिवम् ।
स चोवाच नृपस्तस्मै यदागमनकारणम् ॥

meaning.en: Lord of kings, he asked the king what he needed, and the king told him the reason he had come.

verses.text:
अयं ब्रह्मन्नितो राजा वीतहव्यो विसर्ज्यताम् ।
अस्य पुत्रैर्हि मे ब्रह्मन्कृत्स्नो वंशः प्रणाशितः ।
उत्सादितश्च विषयः काशीनां रत्नसंचयः ॥

meaning.en: Brahmin, let this king Vitahavya, who is here, be handed over. His sons destroyed my whole family and laid waste the land of the Kashis, that storehouse of jewels.

verses.text:
एतस्य वीर्यदृप्तस्य हतं पुत्रशतं मया ।
अस्येदानीं वधाद्ब्रह्मन्भविष्याम्यनृणः पितुः ॥

meaning.en: I have slain a hundred sons of this man, proud of his strength. Now by killing him, brahmin, I will be free of my debt to my father.

verses.text:
तमुवाच कृपाविष्टो भृगुर्धर्मभृतां वरः ।
नेहास्ति क्षत्रियः कश्चित्सर्वे हीमे द्विजातयः ॥

meaning.en: Moved by compassion, Bhrigu, best of upholders of dharma, said to him: There is no kshatriya here. All of these are twice-born.

verses.text:
एवं तु वचनं श्रुत्वा भृगोस्तथ्यं प्रतर्दनः ।
पादावुपस्पृश्य शनैः प्रहसन्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this truthful word of Bhrigu, Pratardana touched his feet, laughed gently, and said:

verses.text:
एवमप्यस्मि भगवन्कृतकृत्यो न संशयः ।
यदेष राजा वीर्येण स्वजातिं त्याजितो मया ॥

meaning.en: Even so, venerable one, I have certainly accomplished my purpose, for by my strength I have made this king give up his own class.

verses.text:
अनुजानीहि मां ब्रह्मन्ध्यायस्व च शिवेन माम् ।
त्याजितो हि मया जातिमेष राजा भृगूद्वह ॥

meaning.en: Give me leave, brahmin, and think kindly of me. Bhrigu's descendant, I have made this king lose his class.

verses.text:
ततस्तेनाभ्यनुज्ञातो ययौ राजा प्रतर्दनः ।
यथागतं महाराज मुक्त्वा विषमिवोरगः ॥

meaning.en: Then, permitted by Bhrigu, King Pratardana went back as he had come, great king, like a snake that has shed its poison.

verses.text:
भृगोर्वचनमात्रेण स च ब्रह्मर्षितां गतः ।
वीतहव्यो महाराज ब्रह्मवादित्वमेव च ॥

meaning.en: By Bhrigu's word alone, Vitahavya became a brahmin sage, and indeed an expounder of the Veda.

verses.text:
तस्य गृत्समदः पुत्रो रूपेणेन्द्र इवापरः ।
शक्रस्त्वमिति यो दैत्यैर्निगृहीतः किलाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: His son was Gritsamada, who in looks was like a second Indra, and whom the daitya seized once, thinking him Indra.

verses.text:
ऋग्वेदे वर्तते चाग्र्या श्रुतिरत्र विशां पते ।
यत्र गृत्समदो ब्रह्मन्ब्राह्मणैः स महीयते ॥

meaning.en: Lord of the people, a foremost Vedic hymn of the Rigveda is attached to him, in which brahmins praise Gritsamada.

verses.text:
स ब्रह्मचारी विप्रर्षिः श्रीमान्गृत्समदोऽभवत् ।
पुत्रो गृत्समदस्यापि सुचेता अभवद्द्विजः ॥

meaning.en: The resplendent Gritsamada became a celibate student and a brahmin sage. Gritsamada's son was the brahmin Suchetas.

verses.text:
वर्चाः सुतेजसः पुत्रो विहव्यस्तस्य चात्मजः ।
विहव्यस्य तु पुत्रस्तु वितत्यस्तस्य चात्मजः ॥

meaning.en: Suchetas's son was Varcha, whose son was Vihavya, and Vihavya's son was Vitatya.

verses.text:
वितत्यस्य सुतः सत्यः सन्तः सत्यस्य चात्मजः ।
श्रवास्तस्य सुतश्चर्षिः श्रवसश्चाभवत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: Vitatya's son was Satya, Satya's son was Santa, his son was the sage Shrava, and Shrava's son was Tamas.

verses.text:
तमसश्च प्रकाशोऽभूत्तनयो द्विजसत्तमः ।
प्रकाशस्य च वागिन्द्रो बभूव जयतां वरः ॥

meaning.en: Tamas's son was Prakasha, best of brahmins, and Prakasha's son was Vagindra, a best of conquerors.

verses.text:
तस्यात्मजश्च प्रमतिर्वेदवेदाङ्गपारगः ।
घृताच्यां तस्य पुत्रस्तु रुरुर्नामोदपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: His son was Pramati, master of the Vedas and their limbs. By Ghritachi he had a son named Ruru.

verses.text:
प्रमद्वरायां तु रुरोः पुत्रः समुदपद्यत ।
शुनको नाम विप्रर्षिर्यस्य पुत्रोऽथ शौनकः ॥

meaning.en: To Ruru and Pramadvara was born the sage Shunaka, and Shunaka's son was Shaunaka.

verses.text:
एवं विप्रत्वमगमद्वीतहव्यो नराधिपः ।
भृगोः प्रसादाद्राजेन्द्र क्षत्रियः क्षत्रियर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Thus, king, best of kshatriyas, King Vitahavya attained brahminhood through Bhrigu's grace.

verses.text:
तथैव कथितो वंशो मया गार्त्समदस्तव ।
विस्तरेण महाराज किमन्यदनुपृच्छसि ॥

meaning.en: In the same way I have told you in detail the line of Gritsamada. Great king, what else do you wish to ask?
